name: Profile picture, search and helper
notes: Light theme by default. Add your own profile picture on the home screen. New Search button that finds any feature or setting. The Helper (assistant) now answers in English, Roman Nepali or Nepali and shows step-by-step guides with pictures. Declining the Terms closes the app. Stricter WebView settings. App tour and start animation removed. Signed with the same key as 2.4.0 and 2.4.1. It cannot be installed over any older version (2.3.0 and earlier): save a backup file first, uninstall the old app, install this one, then restore.

name: Earlier version (no Play Protect warning on the developer's phone)
notes: Same core features as 2.1.0 (accounts, income, expenses, transfers, investments, calculator), without the newer search, profile picture and helper. On the developer's phone and on one other phone, Google Play Protect showed no warning for this version, while later builds were blocked. That does not guarantee the same on your phone. It uses an older signing key, so it cannot be installed over 2.4.x and 2.4.x cannot be installed over it: make a backup, uninstall one, install the other, then restore. It will not receive updates.
